title: Implement GCS Engine primitives conformance slice
body:
## Goal

Implement the approved GCS engine primitives conformance slice: runtime-dependency-free TypeScript fixed-point values, TIDs, and the selected persisted enums required by the later traits/trait-modifiers slice, with differential verification against pinned GCS Go behavior.

## Normative documents

Read both documents completely before implementation:

- [Approved design](https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/blob/main/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-17-gcs-engine-primitives-design.md)
- [Task-by-task TDD implementation plan](https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/blob/main/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-17-gcs-engine-primitives.md)

Start from `main` at or after commit `49e857247b260453687f386d7be979e4a268fab3`. The implementation plan is the execution checklist; do not substitute an abbreviated implementation.

## Hard preflight: Superpowers is mandatory

Before inspecting implementation details or changing any file:

- Invoke `superpowers:using-superpowers` from `plugin://superpowers@openai-curated-remote`.
- If Superpowers is unavailable, attempt to install that exact official plugin through the environment's supported plugin-install workflow.
- If installation or skill invocation fails, **do not begin the task and do not change files**.
- Record the exact error and attempted installation/invocation steps, report the task as blocked, and comment on this issue when access permits.
- No manual workflow fallback is authorized when this preflight fails.

After preflight succeeds, the execution must actually use the applicable Superpowers workflows:

- `superpowers:using-git-worktrees`;
- `superpowers:subagent-driven-development`, with a fresh implementation subagent per plan task and two-stage review;
- `superpowers:test-driven-development`, with observed RED → GREEN cycles;
- `superpowers:systematic-debugging` for unexpected failures;
- `superpowers:verification-before-completion`;
- `superpowers:requesting-code-review`.

Use `superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents` only after proving the delegated tasks do not share files, mutable state, or unresolved interfaces. The primary agent remains responsible for reviewing and integrating every subagent result. Merely mentioning or detecting the plugin does not satisfy this requirement.

## GCS and fixture availability

Do not depend on `~/app/dragon-reaper/GCS`, `/GCS`, or any other contributor-specific/uncommitted host path.

- Mandatory fixtures are committed under `fixtures/gcs-v5/`.
- Fixture provenance and SHA-256 digests are committed in `fixtures/gcs-v5/manifest.json`.
- GCS is pinned to `github.com/richardwilkes/gcs/v5 v5.44.0`.
- Toolbox is pinned to `github.com/richardwilkes/toolbox/v2 v2.15.0`.
- The Docker/Go module workflow obtains the pinned source used by the test-only oracle.
- `GCS_CORPUS_DIR` remains optional for `pnpm test:corpus`; it is not part of the canonical gate and must not become a hidden prerequisite.

Run the exact pinned-source preflight from the implementation plan. If the pinned modules cannot be obtained and are not cached, stop and report the blocker. Do not use a moving branch, copy an unpinned implementation, replace the oracle, or weaken tests.

Relevant upstream paths are listed in the plan and include GCS `model/fxp`, selected `model/gurps/enums`, `model/kinds/kinds.go`, Toolbox `fixed/fixed64`, and Toolbox `tid/tid.go`.

## Deliverables

Follow all eight tasks in the implementation plan:

- [ ] Stable test-only `gcs-primitives-oracle` JSONL process.
- [ ] Pinned Go fixed-point oracle operations and tests.
- [ ] TypeScript branded `Fxp` codec and typed primitive errors.
- [ ] TypeScript fixed-point arithmetic and rounding parity.
- [ ] TID validation, kind narrowing, and cryptographic generation.
- [ ] Selected persisted enum tables, strict parsers, compatibility normalizers, and visible diagnostics.
- [ ] Deterministic TypeScript-to-Go differential conformance tests.
- [ ] Built-package smoke coverage, documentation, licensing notices, canonical-gate integration, and final Superpowers review.

Use the exact API names, enum tables, JSONL operations, test vectors, commands, task boundaries, and commit checkpoints specified in the plan.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Existing `parseGcsV5` and `serializeGcsV5` behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] `@gcs/gcs-engine` has zero runtime dependencies and no production Go requirement.
- [ ] Fixed-point parsing, formatting, arithmetic, rounding, signed boundaries, wrapping/saturation, and errors conform to the pinned oracle under the approved compatibility policy.
- [ ] TIDs accept only `t`, `T`, `m`, and `M`, use exactly 12 cryptographically random bytes, and never fall back to `Math.random`.
- [ ] Strict enum parsers reject unknown values; compatibility normalization exposes `LEGACY_ALIAS` or `FALLBACK_DEFAULT` rather than silently repairing input.
- [ ] Required tests use committed fixtures and pinned modules without a host-specific GCS directory.
- [ ] No committed fixture, provenance digest, unknown-field preservation rule, or `third_party` behavior is changed.
- [ ] The complete gate passes from the canonical environment:
  ```sh
  docker compose run --rm toolchain pnpm check
  ```
- [ ] CI invokes that same gate.
- [ ] Superpowers code review is completed and accepted findings are resolved through TDD.
- [ ] Final report contains task commits, subagent review checkpoints, RED/GREEN evidence, final gate/audit/dependency results, deviations, and the exact `AGENTS.md` candidate from the plan.

## Out of scope

Do not implement typed trait adapters, trait cost calculation, `Recalculate` parity, tree mutations, folders, DnD, context menus, search, UI, Next.js, shadcn/ui, Prisma, PostgreSQL, authentication, older GCS data versions, or a production Go dependency.

Do not edit `packages/gcs-engine/AGENTS.md` automatically. Present the exact candidate from Task 8 for user approval.

## Stop conditions

Stop with a clean worktree and report evidence instead of proceeding when:

- mandatory Superpowers cannot be installed or invoked;
- pinned upstream modules cannot be obtained;
- the baseline canonical gate fails and the cause cannot be resolved in scope;
- implementation requires a new production dependency, public API deviation, persisted-contract change, weakened validation, or other material workaround without user approval.

Use the sentence `No silent workaround was used` only when it is factually true.
